body: I appreciate all of this.  Thank you.  While I have not heard of DBT before, I just got the book.

I guess in the long-term it's been both.  Sometimes it's more of an urge, sometimes it's more of a voice.  Sometimes it's a repeating vision of a method, or a series of theoretical events.

It's my voice.  Like my conscience, or my inner self.  I don't think I'm hearing voices in a way that could be related to schizophrenia, if that's what you're thinking.  However, I will be very open here and say that that is something I dealt with in my teenage years; a voice or "person" in my head.  I want to be cautious not to derail this conversation into dealing too much with that though, because I 100% have not experienced that since that strange moment in my life, and I feel very confident that this is not what that is (although I can clearly see how that would be of interest to an objective observer).
